item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi phyag bzhes sbas pa mig 'byed
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi phyag bzhes sbas pa mig 'byed 'di nyid/ snyigs dus kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rig 'dzin kun grol grags pas (pa'i) yang srid rigs mchog smon lam btsun po smra seng bsnyems pa'i lang tsho gsar pa dang / rlung sems byin chu dbang rgyal zung gis bskul ngor/ rgyal dbang bdag gis sna tshogs dbyig zhes pa shing sbrul gyi lo dri zhim zla ba'i dkar phyogs su bgyis shing*/ mthar yang srid rin po che nyid kyi legs par brgyan pa'i dge des rgyal bstan rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
